Flow.description:
SFP-5728 This flow is triggered by the team and service type selected on the LWC on the case. Input values are required namely:
CMN_Team__c.Id SVC_ServiceTeam__c.Id Case.Id Case.isEscalated isTransferred
SFP-26939 - Queries Management. When the case is created using a 'Global team', we have it stamped in Service team. But the Global Team does not have all information needed for all the automation processes(email templates, email address, etc.). So if the team that the case was created under, e.g. Global Team, is different from the actual team of a team it was routed to we are to use the case owner's team to extract all the information for automation purposes. SFP - 34141 Update classification date only when blank. SFP-40336 - Email Logging Template for email to case complaint SFP-44420 - PPB SA Complaints: Notification to banker SFP-46724 - Updated the Flow to send classification acknowledgment emails to SA Insurance Complaints clients SFP-35988 - SA Complaints Management | SMS functionality SFP-52546 Align Handoff SLA with Parent Case for PPB SA Complaints SFP-49565 - Include Private Heads on Classification and Resolution Notifications
Flow.label: SVC Case Defaults - Set New
